title: LungCT-NET: An Explainable Transfer Learning-Based Robust Ensemble Model for Lung Cancer Diagnosis
summary: An explainable, transfer-learning-based ensemble model for lung cancer diagnosis, published in Knowledge-Based Systems (Q1, Elsevier).

meta.abstract: Builds on ensemble transfer-learning work for lung nodule classification, adding explainable AI so that classification decisions on CT imagery can be inspected and trusted rather than taken as a black box.
